title: Aurora Run
summary: A courier training run through glowing harbor lanes that rewards route timing and lane bonus mastery.
instructions: Use Arrow keys or A / D to switch lanes, follow dispatch, and choose the right harbor lane for bonus score.

overlay.startCopy: Launch into the glowing harbor circuit, chase lane bonuses, and keep the route flowing before the tide shifts.

help.title: Harbor Dispatch Briefing
steps: Press Start to begin the courier training run.
Use Arrow keys or A / D to switch lanes and dodge incoming obstacles.
Stay in the route branch lane during handoff windows to earn bonus score.
Complete the recovery stage when unlocked by high-score runs.
The current dispatch line appears at the bottom of the screen during each stage.
tips: Lane-specific bonuses give extra score for staying in the right harbor lane.
A smooth lane streak earns combo rewards during sprint mode.
High scores will unlock expert recovery drills and a retro harbor skin.

onboarding.title: Get Started
startSteps: Open the help panel if you want the dispatch briefing.
Press the start button on the overlay to launch the run.
Watch the first handoff stage and choose the bonus lane for extra score.
onboarding.firstGoal: Complete the handoff stage and survive the sprint.
